lock_policy: Dated official pick files are append-only. A published pick is never changed or removed once it is on the card. New picks CAN be appended during the day as they qualify — pitcher strikeout picks require the real posted starting lineup, which for a late game does not exist until the early evening, so the card is expected to grow as the slate progresses.
note: Official records are separated by market. Moneylines use the 61% probability and 8.0/10 Lab gates; game totals are currently paused while the totals setup rating is rebuilt (see EXP-20260727-01); pitcher Ks use a 0.7-K edge, posted price, two-book coverage, a confirmed non-opener workload, and the real posted starting lineup (not a projected one). No market publishes an official pick at a price of -185 or shorter — a favourite that heavy has to win 64.9% of the time just to break even, and LyDia's graded record does not support paying that. MANUAL ENTRY NOTE, 2026-08-06: the four strikeout picks below were built by hand during a GitHub Actions outage, from numbers Lynold supplied directly rather than a live pipeline run. Three of the four (Ryan Johnson's game, Brandon Young; and Mason Barnett/Andrew Abbott's game) were already in progress at the time these were recorded -- published per Lynold's explicit instruction after that was disclosed to him. Lab Rating, pitcher-edge, and bullpen context are not available for these three game groups because the underlying model did not run.
